- WikiLeaks posts a video showing a US military helicopter firing on and killing two journalists and several Iraqi civilians in 2007.
The military claims that the helicopter crew believed the targets were armed insurgents, not civilians.
- WikiLeaks posts more than 90,000 classified documents related to the Afghanistan war.
- WikiLeaks publishes classified military documents from the Iraq war.
- WikiLeaks begins publishing diplomatic cables from US embassies.
The site says the documents will be released in stages "over the next few months."
- WikiLeaks releases its archive of more than a quarter million US diplomatic cables.
